name: quorum-verdict-ledger-provenance-gate
title: Bind host quorum verdict evidence to host_run usage-ledger rows (shadow to warn to enforce)
description: Root fix for the B-8038 class of burn incidents (2026-07-12: ~0.92B real input in one day because a story lifecycle ran on unmetered Codex Desktop agent-teams instead of metered host_run lanes). Today the review escalation quorum accepts host verdict evidence (quorum_submit / autopilot_review_submit) on the submitter's word: nothing verifies that the claimed independent host run actually happened through the metered B-70e9 host_run choke point. Since Proof-or-Stop gates check evidence content but not execution provenance, the cheapest execution platform wins - and the cheapest platform is the unmetered, uncapped, unledgered desktop agent-team. This story adds a LEDGER-PROVENANCE check: when quorum host verdict evidence is recorded (quorum_submit) and when the DONE-side review escalation gate consumes it, the claimed host verdicts must be corroborated by usage-ledger rows written by host_run (provider + storyId + phase-appropriate agentType, recorded within a plausible time window; B-70e9 already binds reviewRunId->threadId and lane->subagentId on those rows). Rollout is staged like candidate-spec routing: shadow (report-only diagnostics) -> warn (visible warning lines on submit and in escalation status) -> enforce (quorum_submit refuses unbacked verdicts), with the mode in lattice.config.json and shadow as the default. Lane reviewer passes (in-session subagents with readManifest signatures) are explicitly OUT of scope - this binds only the evidence class that claims INDEPENDENT HOST runs.
